/pages/faq.title: FAQ | EverLiv | EverLiv LLC
/pages/faq.desc: Answers about EverLiv shipping, returns, Subscribe & Save, the Member Price Club, oral strips and lab documents.
/pages/faq.text:
Frequently Asked Questions
    Can't find your answer? Email support@everliv.life and we'll get back to you.
Orders & shipping
How long does shipping take?Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after payment. Standard delivery then usually takes 3–7 business days. Orders don't ship on weekends or holidays.
Where do you ship?We ship throughout the United States for free. We also ship to select countries; international shipping is charged at cost and shown at checkout, and import duties or taxes may apply.
How much is shipping?Nothing. Standard shipping is free on every U.S. order, with no minimum. Subscribe & Save deliveries ship free too. See our Shipping Policy.
How do I track my order?When your order ships, we email you a tracking number. You can also check it on our Track Order page.
My package is lost or damaged. What should I do?Email support@everliv.life within 7 days of delivery with your order number, and we'll sort it out.
Returns
Can I return a product?Yes. New, unopened products bought on everliv.life can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Opened or used products can't be returned. Email support@everliv.life to start a return. Full details are in our Refund & Return Policy.
Subscribe & Save
How does Subscribe & Save work?Choose Subscribe & Save on a product page to save up to 15% on every delivery (each product page shows its exact Subscribe & Save price). Your saved payment method is charged automatically before each delivery until you cancel.
Is there a minimum commitment?No. You can skip or cancel your subscription any time before your next billing date, from your account or by emailing support@everliv.life.
How do I skip, change or cancel?Go to My Account → Manage Subscriptions, or email support@everliv.life. To stop the next charge, cancel before your next billing date.
Membership
Can I join the Member Price Club?New sign-ups for the free Member Price Club are closed while we prepare our paid annual founding membership, which opens soon. See membership details. Questions about pricing on your existing account? Email support@everliv.life. Member pricing can't be combined with other discount codes.
Products
How do I use the oral strips?Place a strip on your tongue and let it dissolve. No water needed. Follow the directions on the label for how many to take and when.
What is the Ultimate Bundle?Pick any 3 strips: mix and match, or choose 3 of the same. Build your bundle.
Where can I see what's in a product?Every product page lists the ingredients and the amount per serving, the same as the label.
Is it safe to take your supplements with medication, or while pregnant or nursing?Please check with your doctor before starting any supplement, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication or have a medical condition.
Are your products FDA approved?Dietary supplements aren't approved by the FDA. These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. Our products are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

Refund policy
  
  
    
        EVERLIV LLC30 N Gould St. Ste RSheridan, WY 82801www.everliv.lifesupport@everliv.life
Last Updated: 8/20/2026
Returns
We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase from EverLiv LLC. If you are not satisfied, you may return eligible products under the following conditions:
Eligibility: Only new, unopened items purchased directly from www.everliv.life may be returned.
Return Window: Returns must be initiated within 30 days of the delivery date.
Condition: Products must be returned in their original, unopened packaging and in resalable condition.
Non-Returnable Items: Opened, used, or damaged products are not eligible for return. Certain items, such as perishable goods or personalized products, may not be eligible for return.
Refunds
Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund.
If approved, your refund will be processed, and a credit will automatically be applied to your original method of payment within 5-10 business days.
Shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund unless the return is due to our error (e.g., you received an incorrect or defective item).
Exchanges
We only replace items if they are defective or damaged. If you need to exchange an item for the same product, please contact us at support@everliv.life.
Return Process
To initiate a return, please contact us at support@everliv.life with your order number and reason for return.
We will provide you with instructions and a return shipping address.
You are responsible for paying for your own shipping costs for returning your item, unless the return is due to our error.
Damaged or Incorrect Items
If you receive a damaged or incorrect item, please contact us within 7 days of delivery at support@everliv.life. We will arrange for a replacement or refund as appropriate.
Questions
If you have any questions about our return policy, please contact us at support@everliv.life.

Shipping policy
  
  
    
        EVERLIV LLC30 N Gould St. Ste RSheridan, WY 82801everliv.lifesupport@everliv.life
Last Updated: November 4, 2026
Free U.S. shipping on every order
Free Shipping: Standard shipping is free on every order within the United States. There is no minimum order amount.
Order Processing: Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after payment is received. Orders are not shipped or delivered on weekends or holidays.
Shipping Methods: We use reputable carriers such as USPS, UPS and FedEx. The carrier is chosen based on your location and the size and weight of your order.
Delivery Time: Standard shipping usually takes 3–7 business days after your order has been processed. Delivery times may vary by location and carrier delays.
Order Tracking: When your order ships, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information. You can also check it on our Track Order page.
Subscriptions: Subscribe & Save deliveries also ship free.
International Shipping
Free shipping applies to orders shipped within the United States. We ship to select international destinations at cost: the shipping charge is calculated and shown at checkout before you pay. International orders may be subject to import duties and taxes, which are the customer's responsibility.
Incorrect or Incomplete Addresses
Please make sure your shipping address is correct at checkout. EverLiv LLC is not responsible for orders shipped to an incorrect or incomplete address provided by the customer. If a package is returned to us because of an incorrect address, we will contact you to arrange reshipment. Additional shipping charges may apply for reshipment.
Lost or Damaged Packages
If your order is lost or arrives damaged, please contact us at support@everliv.life within 7 days of delivery. We will work with you to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
Questions
If you have any questions about our shipping policy, please contact us at support@everliv.life.
